title: R2WP wire version 0 numeric registries and layouts

later_expansion.jazzy_plus: Post-first-stage support-matrix expansion; outside phase-one wire qualification rows.

bootstrap.version_selection: Server selects the first ClientHello.wire_versions entry that the server supports.

extension_capabilities.list_rules: Unique ascending capability IDs. ServerHello.extension_capabilities is the deterministic intersection of client and server offered sets, sorted ascending unique.

control_extensions.description: Future v0 additive control fields outside core keys 1..127 require a registered capability and an additive schema binding.
control_extensions.message_key_schema_binding: Each control_extensions assignment names capability_id, control kind(s), field key range 128..65535, and schema fragment id. Core CDDL remains closed over assigned keys 1..127 until a capability registers additive keys.

default_frames.sender: Contiguous from 0; wrap prohibited. See sender_sequence_exhaustion for u64 exhaustion.
default_frames.reliable_receiver: Exact next sequence required; mismatch is protocol_violation.
default_frames.best_effort_receiver: Applies to datagrams and sample-scoped streams: allow gaps (sequence_gap), latest-wins, drop seq <= highest_accepted as stale_sequence.

service_action_operation_streams.sender: Contiguous from 0 per operation stream; wrap prohibited. See sender_sequence_exhaustion.
service_action_operation_streams.reliable_receiver: Exact next within the operation stream; mismatch is protocol_violation. Applies to Service frames and Action GOAL/CANCEL/RESULT, and to FEEDBACK/STATUS when effective reliability is RELIABLE.
service_action_operation_streams.best_effort_receiver: Applies to ACTION_FEEDBACK/ACTION_STATUS when effective reliability is BEST_EFFORT: allow gaps (sequence_gap), drop seq <= highest_accepted as stale_sequence.
service_action_operation_streams.resume: Service/Action operation streams reset or close on session resume and never byte-resume under wire version 0.

close_channel_final_sequence.applies_to: Sender-direction final sequence on the default channel sequence domain.

control_domain.condition: Sender would assign next sequence beyond u64 maximum on channel_id 0 (CONTROL_CBOR sequence domain).
control_domain.behavior: MUST NOT wrap. Close the session/transport.
control_domain.signaling: If the control stream can still carry a final Error frame, send CONTROL Error with code sequence_exhausted and scope=session, then close transport. Otherwise close transport without a final frame.

default_domain.condition: Sender would assign next sequence beyond u64 maximum on application default (channel_id, direction).
default_domain.behavior: MUST NOT wrap. Close that application channel.
default_domain.signaling: Send CONTROL Error with code sequence_exhausted, scope=channel, channel_id set, when the control stream can carry it; then emit CloseChannel for that channel when applicable.

operation_domain.condition: Sender would assign next sequence beyond u64 maximum on (channel_id, OPERATION_ID, direction).
operation_domain.behavior: MUST NOT wrap. End that operation stream.
operation_domain.signaling: Send CONTROL Error with code sequence_exhausted, scope=operation, channel_id set, and exactly one OPERATION_ID TLV for the exhausted operation, when the control stream can carry it.

receiver.reliable: exact next sequence required; mismatch protocol_violation

BEST_EFFORT.datagram: when negotiated and frame fits maxDatagramSize
BEST_EFFORT.sample_scoped_stream: when datagram unavailable or frame exceeds maxDatagramSize

receiver.reliable: exact next sequence required; mismatch protocol_violation
receiver.best_effort: gap -> sequence_gap disposition; stale -> stale_sequence disposition

receiver.reliable: exact next sequence required; mismatch protocol_violation

BEST_EFFORT.datagram: when negotiated and frame fits maxDatagramSize
BEST_EFFORT.sample_scoped_stream: when datagram unavailable or frame exceeds maxDatagramSize

receiver.reliable: exact next sequence required; mismatch protocol_violation
receiver.best_effort: gap -> sequence_gap disposition; stale -> stale_sequence disposition

receiver.reliable: exact next sequence required; mismatch protocol_violation

payload_channel_mapping.note: Standard ROS parameter service calls compose Service channels; policy/audit classify the higher-level parameter operation.

serialization.format: RFC 8949 core deterministic CBOR map using registry keys
serialization.maps: closed over assigned keys for that opcode
serialization.aggregate_ceiling: frame payload must satisfy frame_payload_max_bytes including CBOR map overhead

rules: MEDIA_CHUNK application payload is one deterministic CBOR map with keys 1..5 only.
codec MUST equal the encoding negotiated on OpenChannel for that media channel.
is_config true carries decoder configuration for stream_generation; receivers MUST apply config before non-config access units of the same stream_generation.
stream_generation increments on codec or parameter reset; receivers discard buffers from prior generations.
KEYFRAME flag marks random-access media access units; it does not replace FRAGMENT (still reserved/prohibited).
Each MEDIA_CHUNK is one opcode-defined semantic access unit, not a generic application fragment.
MEDIA_CHUNK.scope_note: Media rules apply only to MEDIA_CHUNK. Range identity fields (byte_offset, byte_length, total_size, checksum_sha256) are not used on MEDIA_CHUNK.

rules: Range identity and checksum rules apply to RECORDING_CHUNK only.
RECORDING_CHUNK payload is one deterministic CBOR map with keys 1..7 as assigned.
byte_length MUST equal the byte length of the payload bstr (key 7).
encoding MUST equal the channel OpenChannel encoding.
byte_offset + byte_length MUST use checked arithmetic and MUST NOT overflow u64.
When total_size is present, byte_offset + byte_length MUST be <= total_size and total_size MUST be consistent across all chunks of content_id.
When checksum_sha256 is present, it covers the complete content bytes associated with content_id and MUST be identical on every chunk that carries it.
Resume continues from the next unacknowledged absolute byte_offset.
Each chunk is an opcode-defined range unit; FRAGMENT remains reserved.
RECORDING_CHUNK.scope_note: byte_length, byte_offset, total_size, and checksum_sha256 rules apply to RECORDING_CHUNK only (not MEDIA_CHUNK).

rules: Range identity and checksum rules apply to ASSET_CHUNK only.
Same serialization and arithmetic rules as RECORDING_CHUNK with OPAQUE encoding only.
ASSET_CHUNK.scope_note: byte_length, byte_offset, total_size, and checksum_sha256 rules apply to ASSET_CHUNK only (not MEDIA_CHUNK).

source_entry_encodings.note: Distinct from payload encodings. M0-04 owns bundle canonical ordering, bytes, and hash for moonspan-schema-v1 digests.

0x0001.name: ROS_RELIABLE
0x0001.constraint: Legal only on ROS_SAMPLE. Set if and only if the channel effective reliability is RELIABLE. Absent on ROS_SAMPLE when effective reliability is BEST_EFFORT. Any other opcode or mismatch is unsupported_flags.

0x0008.name: RETAINED
0x0008.constraint: Legal only on ROS_SAMPLE when effective durability is TRANSIENT_LOCAL. When set, marks a sample replayed from retained durability history. Live samples MAY clear RETAINED even on TRANSIENT_LOCAL channels. Set on non-ROS_SAMPLE or without TRANSIENT_LOCAL -> unsupported_flags.

application_fragmentation.large_messages: Use a reliable stream; transport segmentation carries the complete frame byte sequence.

4.name: history_depth
4.rules: Required and >=1 when history_kind is KEEP_LAST (1). MUST be absent when history_kind is SYSTEM_DEFAULT (0) or KEEP_ALL (2).

7.name: liveliness
7.effective_rule: MUST be present and concrete (AUTOMATIC or MANUAL_BY_TOPIC) on effective QoS maps

liveliness.note: MANUAL_BY_NODE is not part of R2WP v0.

qos.effective_resolution: OpenChannel and graph advertisements carry requested or role-specific advertised QoS (may include SYSTEM_DEFAULT). Graph endpoint QoS is the role-specific advertised/offered-or-requested profile for that endpoint. OpenChannel carries the requested/created-entity QoS for the channel being opened. Gateway resolves using role-specific ROS request/offered compatibility for the support-row distro. Successful ChannelReady effective_qos / effective_action_qos / effective_service_qos MUST contain only concrete enums with required concrete liveliness; no SYSTEM_DEFAULT values.
qos.service_reliability: Phase-one Service profiles resolve to reliable + volatile. SERVICE_REQUEST and SERVICE_RESPONSE always travel on reliable streams; effective reliability MUST be RELIABLE and effective durability MUST be VOLATILE for Service channels.
qos.action_feedback_status_qos: ACTION_FEEDBACK uses effective_action_qos.feedback_topic; ACTION_STATUS uses effective_action_qos.status_topic. RELIABLE -> reliable stream; BEST_EFFORT -> datagram when negotiated and size-fit, else sample-scoped stream. GOAL/CANCEL/RESULT remain reliable operation streams.

action_profiles.description: ROS action client/server options expose five independent QoS profiles.
action_profiles.wire_mapping: ACTION_GOAL, ACTION_CANCEL, and ACTION_RESULT are request+response on reliable operation streams. ACTION_FEEDBACK and ACTION_STATUS are one-way; transport follows the respective effective feedback_topic and status_topic reliability profiles.

effective_service_qos.open_channel_note: SERVICE_CLIENT and SERVICE_SERVER are both valid browser OpenChannel operation_kind values.

close_reasons.note: CloseChannel MUST use a close_reason. Normal close MUST use NORMAL. MUST NOT reuse wire error code 0.

graph_delta_ops.order: Ops preserve semantic order within a delta. Generation relation: GraphDelta.base_generation MUST equal the receiver's current graph_generation; GraphDelta.graph_generation MUST equal base_generation + 1. add_or_update replaces by stable ID; remove deletes by ID only.

collection_rules.wire_versions: Unique preference order (client preference first); not required sorted numerically.
collection_rules.graph_node_ids: Unique; snapshot order is deterministic bytewise ascending node_id.
collection_rules.graph_endpoint_ids: Unique; snapshot order is deterministic bytewise ascending endpoint_id.
collection_rules.dominating_bound: control_payload_max_bytes (1048576) dominates every nested field and collection size.
collection_rules.extension_tlv_types: Strictly ascending by numeric type within one frame; duplicates prohibited.

rules: TLVs MUST be strictly ascending by numeric type
duplicate extension type -> malformed_frame
non-ascending type order -> malformed_frame
TLV padding MUST be zero
value_len MUST match fixed type size exactly
each TLV MUST lie entirely within extension_len
length sums use checked arithmetic before allocation
unknown critical -> unsupported_extension
unknown noncritical -> skip
TRACE_PRESENT and TRACE_CONTEXT bidirectional consistency required

cbor_profile.name: r2wp-v0-control
rules: definite lengths only
shortest integer and length encodings
map keys in deterministic order
duplicate map keys invalid
unsigned integer map keys only
tags prohibited
floats prohibited
indefinite lengths prohibited

decode_errors.policy: Discard entire message; MUST NOT return partial semantic object. BootstrapError MUST NOT carry invalid_control as its code.

cbor_profile.correlation_id_on_control_error: Echo request correlation_id when trustworthy; otherwise 16 zero bytes.

correlation_id.untrusted_on_error: 16 zero bytes when a control error cannot recover a trustworthy correlation ID.

optional_budget_field_absent.rule: Use the tighter of the absolute protocol ceiling and the session effective limit for that dimension.

20.name: adapter_profile_mismatch
20.note: Out-of-band readiness/startup only. Excluded from every R2WP Error payload (wire-error-code and bootstrap-error-code omit 20).

7.name: liveliness
7.required: required_on_effective_qos; optional on requested/advertised with default SYSTEM_DEFAULT when absent

2.name: shared_arraybuffer
2.note: Path usable only when capability shared_arraybuffer is negotiated.

error_body.note: Generic name only; CDDL uses specialized session-scope and channel-scope embedded maps. No operation-scope embedded body.

channel_scope_embedded.channel_id: absent; enclosing message channel_id is authoritative

5.name: encoding
5.note: CDR1 or XCDR2 only for ROS graph endpoints

7.name: qos
7.note: Role-specific advertised/offered-or-requested profile, not OpenChannel requested QoS.

2.name: acknowledged_sequence
2.reliable: highest contiguous accepted sequence on default domain
2.best_effort: highest accepted sequence on default domain

channel_ack.rules: Entries cover client-received default domains only; omit channels with no accepted frame; exclude Service/Action operation streams.

3.name: next_sequence
3.required: resumed default-domain: required; reset default-domain: required and 0; reset Service/Action: absent; closed: absent; error: absent

15.name: error
15.required: required when result is error; absent otherwise

requested_limits.rules: ClientHello key 4 is a required map; each of the four members is optional. Requested values use native wire integer ranges and are NOT capped by protocol ceilings on the wire. ServerHello effective_limits apply min(client_requested, server_hard_limit, protocol_ceiling). When a client omits a member, effective is min(server_hard_limit, protocol_ceiling).

effective_limits.rules: All four fields present and concrete, each <= its protocol ceiling. If client requested: min(client_requested, server_hard_limit, protocol_ceiling). If client omitted: min(server_hard_limit, protocol_ceiling).

3.name: buffer_capabilities
3.constraint: shared_arraybuffer true only if both offered path and capability 2 negotiated

SessionReady.constraint: support_row_id/ros_distro/rmw_identifier MUST match support_row_profiles exactly; negotiated_capabilities MUST equal ServerHello transport/buffer/extension_capabilities exactly

SchemaResponse.note: success and error variants are mutually exclusive

OpenChannel.discriminator: operation_kind selects CDDL choice: Topic/Service use qos; Action uses action_qos; Media/Recording/Asset omit qos maps

ChannelReady.note: Success allow|limited includes effective_budgets and effective_priority. Topic success adds effective_qos only. Service success adds effective_service_qos only. Action success adds effective_action_qos only (goal/result/cancel profiles use effective-service-qos constraints; feedback/status use general effective-qos). Media/Recording/Asset omit all QoS fields. Failure deny|error has error body only.

35.name: final_sequence
35.rules: Default (channel_id, direction) domain only. MUST be omitted for Service/Action operation-stream channels and when the sender never sent a default-domain data frame.

45.name: channel_acks
45.rules: Client-received default domains only; omit no-accepted-frame channels; exclude Service/Action operation streams.

SessionResume.note: previous_session_id is not a bearer secret. credential_type and credential revalidate identity and expiry. Requires capability 1. channel_acks are default-domain only.

29.name: channel_id
29.required: required when scope is channel or operation; MUST be absent for session, transport, bootstrap

Error.note: Flat CONTROL Error fields. Not nested error_body. Operation scope additionally requires exactly one OPERATION_ID TLV on the frame. Code 20 is never legal in Error payloads.

webtransport.stream_framing: Application length fields delimit records and frames on the byte sequence.
webtransport.datagram_rule: Exactly one complete selected-version best-effort frame matching channel QoS and opcode transport rules (ROS_SAMPLE when topic BEST_EFFORT; ACTION_FEEDBACK/ACTION_STATUS when the respective effective topic reliability is BEST_EFFORT). Size MUST fit negotiated maxDatagramSize.
webtransport.w3c_status: W3C WebTransport API is a Working Draft / work in progress.
webtransport.ietf_status: IETF draft-ietf-webtrans-http3-15 is a work-in-progress Internet-Draft.

binary_wss.message_rule: Exactly one complete bootstrap record or selected-version frame per WebSocket message.
binary_wss.fragmentation: WebSocket transport fragmentation is transparent to R2WP; reassembly yields one complete message.

applies_to: ROS_SAMPLE when effective reliability is BEST_EFFORT
ACTION_FEEDBACK when effective_action_qos.feedback_topic reliability is BEST_EFFORT
ACTION_STATUS when effective_action_qos.status_topic reliability is BEST_EFFORT
best_effort_topic_and_action_feedback_st.admission: Bounded latest-wins admission and eviction BEFORE write to the WebSocket.
best_effort_topic_and_action_feedback_st.dropped_before_write: Receiver observes sequence_gap for frames dropped by admission/eviction.
best_effort_topic_and_action_feedback_st.after_write: Once frame bytes are written to the WebSocket, delivery is reliable under RFC 6455 (no post-write best-effort drop).

head_of_line.limitation: Single ordered WebSocket byte stream imposes head-of-line blocking across concurrent logical channels and best-effort traffic.
head_of_line.note: Recorded for dual-transport fixture comparison with WebTransport datagrams; not a protocol_violation.

operation_frame_transport_rule.sequence_domain_all: (channel_id, OPERATION_ID, direction) for every Service and Action application frame
operation_frame_transport_rule.service: SERVICE_REQUEST and SERVICE_RESPONSE always use reliable_stream
operation_frame_transport_rule.action_goal_cancel_result: ACTION_GOAL, ACTION_CANCEL, ACTION_RESULT always use reliable_stream
operation_frame_transport_rule.action_feedback_status: ACTION_FEEDBACK uses effective_action_qos.feedback_topic.reliability; ACTION_STATUS uses effective_action_qos.status_topic.reliability; RELIABLE -> reliable_stream; BEST_EFFORT -> datagram (WebTransport when negotiated and size-fit) or sample_scoped_stream / WSS best-effort path

hello_negotiation.version_selection: First ClientHello.wire_versions entry the server supports.
hello_negotiation.extension_capabilities: Unique ascending lists; ServerHello is unique ascending intersection.
hello_negotiation.transport_booleans: Effective webtransport_http3 and binary_wss are AND of peer offers. At least the transport used by the current connection MUST remain true after negotiation.
hello_negotiation.max_datagram_size: When datagrams are used, effective max_datagram_size is min(client_offer, server_offer, actual WebTransport negotiated maxDatagramSize, frame_payload_max_bytes + 32 + extension_area_max_bytes). ServerHello always includes a concrete value when either peer offered datagrams or the connection uses WebTransport datagrams.

effective_limits.client_omit_rule: When the client omits a requested limit field, the effective value is the server configured hard limit capped by the protocol absolute ceiling for that field.
effective_limits.client_present_rule: When the client requests a limit field, effective is min(client_requested, server_hard_limit, protocol_absolute_ceiling). client_requested may exceed the ceiling; the ceiling is applied only when computing effective_limits.
effective_limits.max_channels: If client requested: min(client_requested, server_hard_limit, max_channels_ceiling). If client omitted: min(server_hard_limit, max_channels_ceiling).
effective_limits.max_session_bytes: If client requested: min(client_requested, server_hard_limit, max_session_bytes_ceiling). If client omitted: min(server_hard_limit, max_session_bytes_ceiling).
effective_limits.max_message_bytes: If client requested: min(client_requested, server_hard_limit, frame_payload_max_bytes). If client omitted: min(server_hard_limit, frame_payload_max_bytes).
effective_limits.max_control_payload_bytes: If client requested: min(client_requested, server_hard_limit, control_payload_max_bytes). If client omitted: min(server_hard_limit, control_payload_max_bytes).

field_mappings.max_message_bytes: Maps to absolute frame_payload_max_bytes as the protocol ceiling.
field_mappings.max_control_payload_bytes: Maps to absolute control_payload_max_bytes as the protocol ceiling.

hello_negotiation.shared_arraybuffer: Effective buffer_capabilities.shared_arraybuffer is true only when both peers offered key 2 true and capability 2 is in ServerHello.extension_capabilities.
hello_negotiation.session_ready_match: SessionReady.negotiated_capabilities MUST equal ServerHello transport_capabilities, buffer_capabilities, and extension_capabilities.

rules: Responses MUST echo the request correlation_id.
Unsolicited GraphSnapshot, GraphDelta, SchemaAdvertise, CloseChannel, ClockSync, Heartbeat, and Error use 16 zero bytes unless the Error is the scoped response to a trustworthy request.
When ChannelReady or a channel-scoped Error carries nested error_body.channel_id, it MUST equal the top-level channel_id context.

order: Client MUST send exactly one ClientHello first.
Server MUST respond with exactly one ServerHello or exactly one BootstrapError.
No other bootstrap kinds are permitted on the connection.
bootstrap.on_BootstrapError: Close transport without entering selected-version plane.

selected_plane_entry.fresh: Client sends Authenticate; server responds SessionReady or Error. Ready state begins only after SessionReady.
selected_plane_entry.resume: Requires capability 1. Client sends SessionResume including credential_type and credential; server responds SessionResumeResult or Error. Ready state begins only after accepted SessionResumeResult. previous_session_id is not a bearer secret; credentials revalidate identity and expiry.
selected_plane_entry.mutual_exclusivity: Authenticate and SessionResume are mutually exclusive entry messages for a connection. Sending both, repeating an entry message after a response has been received, or wrong direction/order yields protocol_violation.

protocol_state_machine.ready_state: Ready state begins only after SessionReady or accepted SessionResumeResult. ready_required_control_kinds and data-plane application frames received before ready yield session_not_ready. Error remains legal after selected-version plane entry according to its scope. Illegal ordering that is not a readiness issue yields protocol_violation.

channel_lifecycle.id_allocation: Client allocates a previously unused application channel_id in 1..4294967295. Channel IDs MUST NOT be reused within a session after any OpenChannel for that id.

states.failed: ChannelReady failure (deny|error); ID remains consumed/released terminal without active data.

transitions: failed and closed are terminal for that channel_id

frame_rules.pending: Data-plane application frames on a pending channel_id yield protocol_violation.
frame_rules.never_opened: Data-plane application frames on never-opened or unallocated ids yield unknown_channel.
frame_rules.active: Opcode, direction, effective priority, and transport/QoS context MUST match the active channel operation_kind mapping.

SERVICE_SERVER.open_channel: valid browser OpenChannel role; browser hosts the service
SERVICE_SERVER.note: Graph endpoint kind SERVICE_SERVER remains an independent graph advertisement role and is not collapsed into OpenChannel.

ACTION_RESULT.note: Get Result service (ROS 2 actions: three services + two topics).

ACTION_CLIENT.ros2_mapping: Send Goal, Cancel Goal, Get Result services; Feedback and Status topics. Source: https://design.ros2.org/articles/actions.html
ACTION_CLIENT.transport_note: GOAL/CANCEL/RESULT reliable streams; FEEDBACK/STATUS transport from effective_action_qos feedback_topic/status_topic reliability.

ACTION_RESULT.note: Get Result service inverse for browser-hosted action server.

ACTION_SERVER.open_channel: valid browser OpenChannel role; browser hosts the action server
ACTION_SERVER.note: Graph endpoint kind ACTION_SERVER remains an independent graph advertisement role and is not collapsed into OpenChannel.
ACTION_SERVER.ros2_mapping: Send Goal, Cancel Goal, Get Result services; Feedback and Status topics. Source: https://design.ros2.org/articles/actions.html
ACTION_SERVER.transport_note: GOAL/CANCEL/RESULT reliable streams; FEEDBACK/STATUS transport from effective_action_qos feedback_topic/status_topic reliability.

validation_order.precedence_note: Stop at the first failing receiver/input check in order. Every Error row has exactly one error code. CONTROL_CBOR decode and CDDL shape complete before ready-state, Error scope (flat and embedded), and any check that needs control kind. Early static flag/opcode checks precede channel context; ROS_RELIABLE iff reliability and RETAINED requires_transient_local run only after active channel context. Sender-local sequence exhaustion is not in this list.

includes: KEYFRAME legal only when opcode is MEDIA_CHUNK
ROS_RELIABLE and RETAINED legal only when opcode is ROS_SAMPLE (opcode class only; effective-QoS checks later)

selected_frame.note: MUST complete before any check that needs control kind or Error scope.
Uses decoded control kind for CONTROL_CBOR; application data-plane frames also require ready.

selected_frame.applies_when: CONTROL_CBOR kind Error (flat) or embedded error maps in SchemaResponse/SessionResumeResult/ChannelReady/channel-resume-result
selected_frame.note: See error_scope_context for flat and embedded rules. Enclosing channel_id is authoritative for channel-scope embedded bodies.

selected_frame.applies_when: active Service/Action application frame, or Error with scope=operation
selected_frame.note: Exactly one OPERATION_ID TLV when required; all-zero only where lifecycle permits (ACTION_STATUS).

selected_frame.applies_when: ROS_SAMPLE on active channel with known effective reliability
ROS_SAMPLE on active channel with known effective durability
selected_frame.note: RETAINED set requires effective TRANSIENT_LOCAL; clear is always legal on ROS_SAMPLE with TRANSIENT_LOCAL (live samples). Illegal opcode or durability -> unsupported_flags.
Best-effort gap produces sequence_gap disposition, not an Error code.
Best-effort stale produces stale_sequence disposition, not an Error code.

sequence_exhaustion_sender_local.name: sequence_exhausted
sequence_exhaustion_sender_local.note: Sender-local only; not a receiver validation_order row.

document_ownership.json_registry: Numeric assignments, layouts, limits, error codes, validation order/precedence, direction tables, field keys, capability bindings.
document_ownership.cddl: Control and bootstrap payload shapes and bounds.
document_ownership.normative_prose: Semantic rules, state machine, lifecycle, QoS resolution narrative, transport status.
document_ownership.consistency: All three surfaces MUST agree; conflict is a specification defect.

acknowledged_sequence.reliable: Highest contiguous sequence the client accepted without gap on that default domain.
acknowledged_sequence.best_effort: Highest sequence the client accepted on that default domain (gaps permitted; not a contiguous guarantee).

channel_resume_result_next_sequence.meaning: next_sequence is the next sequence number of the channel's active data sender on the default (channel_id, direction) domain. The active data sender side is determined by operation_kind.

active_data_sender_by_operation_kind.SERVICE_CLIENT: not used for next_sequence on resume (operation streams excluded)
active_data_sender_by_operation_kind.SERVICE_SERVER: not used for next_sequence on resume (operation streams excluded)
active_data_sender_by_operation_kind.ACTION_CLIENT: not used for next_sequence on resume (operation streams excluded)
active_data_sender_by_operation_kind.ACTION_SERVER: not used for next_sequence on resume (operation streams excluded)

channel_resume_result_next_sequence.gateway_to_browser_cases: For TOPIC_SUBSCRIBE, MEDIA_SUBSCRIBE, RECORDING, ASSET: next_sequence is the next sequence the gateway/server will send.
channel_resume_result_next_sequence.browser_to_gateway_cases: For TOPIC_PUBLISH: next_sequence is the next sequence the browser/client will send.
channel_resume_result_next_sequence.resumed: Required for default-domain channels that resume. Value is the active data sender's next sequence.
channel_resume_result_next_sequence.reset_default_domain: Present and equal to 0 (active data sender restarts at 0).
channel_resume_result_next_sequence.reset_service_action_channel: Omitted. Operation streams reset or close and never byte-resume.
channel_resume_result_next_sequence.error: Omitted; error body required on the channel-resume-result error variant (nested error_body, not flat Error).

session_resume_semantics.service_action_operation_streams: Reset or close on resume; never byte-resume under wire version 0.

operation_id_lifecycle.format: exactly one OPERATION_ID extension TLV, value_len 16, opaque bytes
operation_id_lifecycle.nonzero_rule: Unless explicitly all-zero for ACTION_STATUS, operation IDs MUST be nonzero.
operation_id_lifecycle.no_reuse: A nonzero operation ID MUST NOT be reused within the same channel for the remainder of the session after first use.

service.initiator_allocates: Service call initiator allocates a unique nonzero 16-byte operation ID per call.
service.response_echoes: SERVICE_RESPONSE MUST echo the request operation ID.
terminal_conditions: SERVICE_RESPONSE accepted for that operation ID
operation-scoped CONTROL Error accepted for that operation ID
service.cancellation: Either peer cancels or terminates a Service call with flat CONTROL Error code cancelled (15), scope=operation, channel_id present, and exactly one OPERATION_ID TLV for the call.
service.deadline_resource: deadline_expired, resource_exhausted, and other operation failures use the same operation-scoped flat CONTROL Error path (code as assigned, scope=operation, channel_id + OPERATION_ID TLV).
service.first_terminal_wins: The first terminal outcome wins. Later application frames for a terminal operation ID are protocol_violation.

action.goal_lifecycle_id: ACTION_GOAL initiator allocates a unique nonzero 16-byte goal-lifecycle operation ID. GOAL response, goal-scoped ACTION_FEEDBACK, Get Result (ACTION_RESULT) request and response, and single-goal ACTION_CANCEL request and response use that same ID.
action.multi_goal_cancel: Multi-goal or all-goal ACTION_CANCEL allocates its own unique nonzero request operation ID distinct from any goal-lifecycle ID. That cancel request ID terminates on cancel response or operation-scoped Error for that cancel ID.
action.status_stream: ACTION_STATUS uses the all-zero 16-byte operation ID as the channel-wide status stream identifier. The zero stream lasts through channel close or session end.
action.ros_goal_uuid: The ROS goal UUID remains inside the CDR payload. The gateway/adapter maps between that UUID and this wire OPERATION_ID; they are not required to be byte-identical.
goal_lifecycle_terminal_conditions: GOAL response rejects the goal (acceptance false / reject path in CDR semantics)
Get Result (ACTION_RESULT) response accepted for that goal-lifecycle ID
operation-scoped CONTROL Error for that goal-lifecycle ID
action.first_terminal_wins: First terminal outcome for a goal-lifecycle ID wins. Later application frames for a terminal goal-lifecycle ID are protocol_violation (except ACTION_STATUS zero stream which is channel-wide).
action.per_direction_sequence: Each (channel_id, OPERATION_ID, direction) stream has independent sequences from 0. Reliable streams require exact next; best-effort FEEDBACK/STATUS use gap/stale dispositions.

error_scope_context.control_error_shape: CONTROL_CBOR kind Error uses flat fields (kind, correlation_id, code, scope, optional channel_id, retry_class, message, detail). These are NOT a nested error_body map. Operation scope uses the frame header OPERATION_ID TLV (exactly one).

channel_ready_failure.channel_id: MUST be absent inside nested error_body; enclosing ChannelReady.channel_id is authoritative

channel_resume_result_error.channel_id: MUST be absent inside nested error_body; enclosing channel_resume_result.channel_id is authoritative

session.use: Session-wide failures after selected plane entry; also embedded SchemaResponse/SessionResumeResult errors

flat_control_error.channel_id: MUST be present and nonzero application channel

channel.embedded: channel_id only on enclosing message, not nested error_body

flat_control_error.channel_id: MUST be present and nonzero application channel
flat_control_error.operation_id_tlv: exactly one OPERATION_ID TLV required on the Error frame

operation.embedded: not used for operation-scoped failures; use flat CONTROL Error

transport.use: Transport-level failures surfaced on control when possible

bootstrap.flat_control_error: MUST NOT appear as post-selection CONTROL Error scope

error_scope_context.correlation: Request/response pairs echo the request correlation_id. Unsolicited control events and untrusted recovery use 16 zero bytes. Flat CONTROL Error that is the scoped response to a trustworthy request echoes that request correlation_id; otherwise 16 zero bytes.
